=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22830-22842, 22969-22989 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In invoke_stall_judge, the `review_waiting_for_runner` hold is applied only on the parsed-judge-action path (22906-22914, 22957-22961). Every fallback path calls `execute_stall_recovery_action ... "${fallback_action}"` without checking the flag: judge_success != "true", empty `_robust_parse_json_file` output, resolve_merge_conflict with no target_pr or head_ref, failed dispatch, and unknown action.
  WHY: With `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=true`, the ai:done ladder (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1689-1692) returns escalate_human at recovery_count 2, the same count at which the judge first fires (`STALL_JUDGE_TRIGGER_COUNT=2`). A judge failure on that tick adds `ai:needs-human` (or runs close_and_reissue) to a PR whose review is only queued for a runner, which Goal 2 forbids.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22894-22914 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hold guard checks `effective_action` only after `normalize_stall_recovery_action` / `resolve_effective_stall_recovery_action` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2303-2328) has downgraded a judged escalate_human to the ladder action. Under the default `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false`, the hold never matches.
  WHY: Under the default config, no `STALL_SKIP ... reason=review_waiting_for_runner` is logged and the ladder action runs instead (for ai:done, retrigger_review may push an empty commit and churn the head SHA). The new tests force terminalization="true", so the default path is untested. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT because the ai:done retrigger_review in-flight guard (20972-20977) returns 1; the others rated it MAJOR. The highest rating is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18641-18644, 22535-22539 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `_stall_judge_review_runs_for_pr` live listing queries only the PR head branch. PR-named workflow_dispatch review runs execute on the default branch and reach recent_review_workflow_outcomes only through the globally capped cached blob (50 queued / 20 completed, 18257-18262). The judge evidence has no PR-named lookup of the kind `_direct_inflight_review_run_on_branch` (18505-18521) adds.
  WHY: In a runner backlog, a PR-named dispatch review run falls outside the cached windows and appears in neither source. `review_waiting_for_runner` stays false and the judge may escalate a PR as "no review ever ran", so Goal 1 is not met.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22548 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The `_stall_review_wait_run_id` jq select `select($head_sha != "" and (.head_sha // "") == $head_sha)` sets the flag only for runs whose head_sha equals the PR head. PR-named dispatch runs carry the default-branch head_sha, so the check always rejects them even when they are in the cached blob.
  WHY: A PR whose review was dispatched through the PR-named workflow_dispatch path, and is waiting in the runner queue, keeps `review_waiting_for_runner=false`, so escalate_human / close_and_reissue run instead of being held.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22509-22578 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The branch-scoped listing is merged with the repo-wide cached blob from `_load_actions_runs_cached` (18257-18264, capped at 50 queued + 20 completed). Under a large backlog, a PR's review runs, including its latest completed run, can fall outside the caps and be absent from both evidence paths.
  WHY: The judge may miss the most recent completed review run, see an empty list, and choose escalate_human / close_and_reissue again on the next tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22560-22571 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On list_failed or merge_failed, `_sjr_outcome="failed"` leaves `_sjr_count=0`, so `STALL_JUDGE_REVIEW_RUNS` logs `runs=0` while `workflow_outcomes` still passes up to 3 cached entries (without head_sha) to the judge.
  WHY: This breaks the contractual log format in agents.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md (runs=<n> is the count the judge saw) and misleads operators and the log-analysis pipeline.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22933-22961 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A held tick posts the judge comment and tg_notify, then returns 1 without increment_stall_recovery or re-anchoring status_since_ts. The judge therefore re-fires every */15 poll tick until REVIEW_RUN_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES (default 250), and judge_decision_cache does not deduplicate these re-fires (not persisted on the standalone path at 26445-26448).
  WHY: During a runner backlog, each waiting issue produces about 16 LLM calls, Stall Judge comments and Telegram messages. That multiplies API pressure exactly when the queue is longest. The existing merge_train_queued and claude_capacity_wait skips return before the LLM call.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2755-2761, 2802-2811 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The linked-PR diff fetch in unblock_ask_model ends in `|| true`, so a failure leaves `pr_diff.txt` empty and logs nothing. `linked_open_pr` is still injected into the judge context, and the prompt says the diff is in the PULL REQUEST DIFF section.
  WHY: The judge is told the diff is present when it is empty, and validation (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:1251) still requires the verdict to name `#<n>`. `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_LINKED_PR` has already logged outcome=found, so operators cannot see the failure. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 NIT, minimax_minimax-m3 MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2755-2760 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The diff fetch in unblock_ask_model is claimed to run on every call, including the re-ask path.
  WHY: Repeated diff reads would be unnecessary work. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state that line 2750 skips the fetch when UNBLOCK_JUDGE_REASK_NOTE is set.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1458-1476, 2755-2760 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Finding a linked PR adds a separate `pulls/<number>` read on top of the PR-list lookup and the diff read.
  WHY: The issue specifies one `pulls?head=...` lookup plus one diff read; this path makes three reads per found PR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18626-18631, 22512-22514 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The §14 audit comment says `_load_actions_runs_cached` lists only in_progress runs, but it also merges `status=queued&per_page=50` and `status=completed&per_page=20` (18256-18264).
  WHY: The audit that justifies the new API call misstates the existing call. The real gap is that the windows are global and capped, not branch-scoped.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "While it is true, `escalate_human` and `close_and_reissue` are downgraded to a no-op wait for that tick, logged `STALL_SKIP ... reason=review_waiting_for_runner`. That tick does not count as a recovery attempt." (Goal 2)
  expected_change_site: invoke_stall_judge in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, on its fallback_action paths (22830-22842, 22969-22989) and before normalization of a judged escalate_human (22894-22900)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The only hold is at 22906-22914 and 22957-22961 and acts on the normalized judge action. No hunk touches the fallback_action call sites. No test covers the default `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false` or a judge failure with the flag true.
- requirement: "Both fail open: on error the context is exactly as today, and `…_fetch outcome=failed` is logged."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_ask_model linked-PR diff fetch (lines 2755-2761) and the context injection at lines 2802-2811
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The diff fetch suppresses failures with `|| true` and logs no failed outcome. `linked_open_pr` is still added to the judge context at 2802-2811 on the strength of the earlier lookup, which already logged `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_LINKED_PR outcome=found`. The prompt (prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt:31) says the diff is present, and validation still refuses retry_budget/reissue/descope verdicts that do not name the PR. The context is therefore not "exactly as today".
- requirement: "`recent_review_workflow_outcomes` includes that PR's review-family runs in every status: queued, waiting, pending, in progress, and the latest completed ones."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the stall-judge review-run lookup and merge into `workflow_outcomes`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The live lookup is branch-scoped. Default-branch workflow_dispatch review runs are matched only by PR name in the cached blob (22485-22510), which is bounded to 50 in-progress, 50 queued and 20 completed runs (18203, 18257-18264) and does not fetch waiting or pending runs. No targeted lookup or pagination for PR-named dispatch runs was added.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:invoke_stall_judge, lines 22830-22842 and 22969-22989 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `review_waiting_for_runner` is computed before the judge runs (about 22520-22572), but the hold only checks the parsed `effective_action` (22906-22914, 22957-22961). Every fallback path runs `fallback_action` unchecked.
  WHY: With terminalization=true, the ai:done ladder (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py lines 1689-1692) gives escalate_human at recovery_count 2, which equals STALL_JUDGE_TRIGGER_COUNT. A judge failure on that tick adds `ai:needs-human` to a PR whose review is queued. Fix: check the flag before each fallback call that would run escalate_human or close_and_reissue.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:invoke_stall_judge, line 22548 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The head_sha equality in the `_stall_review_wait_run_id` jq rejects PR-named dispatch runs (#4618, #4701), which carry the default-branch head_sha. The `--branch <head_ref>` listing never returns them. Compare 22485-22492 and `_direct_inflight_review_run_on_branch` at 18580-18603.
  WHY: A queued PR-named dispatch review keeps the flag false, so escalate_human / close_and_reissue run instead of being held. Fix: accept trust-filtered PR-named entries (22503-22504) from `$cached_outcomes`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:invoke_stall_judge, lines 22894-22914 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With the default terminalization=false, `resolve_effective_stall_recovery_action` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py lines 2326-2327) rewrites escalate_human to the ladder action before the hold check, so no STALL_SKIP is logged. The tests (`_sjr_run_stall_judge`) force "true".
  WHY: Goal 2 is not delivered as written under the default config. The ai:done retrigger_review in-flight guard (20972-20977) limits the impact, but other phases' ladder actions run. Fix: test `judge_action` too.
